derivations.method: STA 20:30 and Off Duty 21:00 are local ORD; the row is not marked +1, but MAD 18:30 (16:30Z) plus the printed 9h00 block lands 02/09 01:30Z, so the ORD clock times belong to 01/09 local = 02/09 UTC
STD 21:50 local ORD on the row date is already 04/09 UTC; STA 13:50 / Off Duty 14:20 local MAD must then be 04/09 local, confirmed by the 9h00 block
STD 23:10 local JFK = 08/09 03:10Z; STA 13:10 / Off Duty 13:40 local MAD placed on 08/09, confirmed by the 8h00 block
CR866 arrives FCO 02:20 and CR563 departs 03:23 / arrives MAD 05:48 with Off Duty 06:18 — all after the 23:55 MAD departure, so assigned to 12/09 local; total duty then equals the printed 14h53
Off Duty 00:14 follows a 23:44 MAD arrival, so it is 25/09 local (24/09 22:14Z); the printed 11h54 duty from report 12:20 confirms it
STA 08:10 / Off Duty 08:40 local SIN with a 13h30 block from MAD 12:40 (10:40Z) puts the arrival on 27/09 local SIN = 27/09 00:10Z
